deduction_set.house-single: The sole candidate in a row, column or zone is forced; remove all its row/column/zone/king-neighbor peers.
deduction_set.shared-conflict: A house must contain one capy. A cell conflicting with EVERY remaining candidate of that house is impossible. Includes locked row/zone intersections and common adjacency exclusion. No branching, no search, no solution lookup.

independent_oracle: Enumerates ALL column permutations; independently checks adjacent rows, zones and rocks. Generation and logic trace do not constrain this enumeration. Runtime JS backtracker cross-checks all 395 boards in unit tests.
